description:
YANLib (YAMI AN NEPHILIM LIBRARY) is a comprehensive .NET utility library providing powerful extension methods that enhance developer productivity. Built on .NET 8 (LTS), it offers high-performance utilities for JSON serialization, text manipulation, object validation, task coordination, mathematical operations, DateTime handling, and more.

			Key features:
			• YANJson: High-performance JSON serialization with robust error handling
			• YANText: String manipulation, validation, and transformation with null safety
			• YANObject: Object validation, property analysis, and deep copying
			• YANTask: Enhanced task coordination with conditional waiting and error handling
			• YANUnmanaged: Type parsing and conversion with built-in error handling
			• YANRandom: Random value generation for various types and collections
			• YANMath: Mathematical operations with null handling and type conversion
			• YANDateTime: Time zone conversion and date calculations
			• YANProcess: Process management utilities
			• YANExpression: Dynamic property access and expression tree utilities

			All components feature fluent APIs, robust null handling, collection support, and performance optimizations. YANLib simplifies common programming tasks while maintaining high performance, making it an essential toolkit for .NET developers.
releaseNotes:
### YANLib 8.4.0 – Correctness, Performance and New Overloads

* **New API**: `ParseWith`/`ParsesWith` (parse with an `IFormatProvider`), `GenerateRandom<T>(T min, T max)` and `Random.NextChar(char min, char max)`, public `YANTask.WaitAnyWithConditions`/`WhenAnyWithConditions`, `YANProcess` overloads with `entireProcessTree` and `CancellationToken`, `onDuplicate` overloads of `Parses`, `ToDictionary`, `ToImmutableDictionary` and `ToImmutableSortedDictionary` for keys that parse to the same value, `Snowflake` `Extract*Components` strategy overloads without the ignored `sequence`, and `IsNull`/`IsNotNull` restored as obsolete shims.
* **Fixes**: `Parse` no longer crashes on out-of-range values and supports `nint`/`nuint`; with a format, a `Parse<DateTime>` string default that does not match it is parsed without it; exact integer/decimal math in `YANMath`, also for a `decimal` `Average` whose running sum overflows; uniform, half-open `YANRandom` ranges; inherited properties, safe graph walks and runtime-type `Copy` in `YANObject`; the per-type caches of `YANObject` and `YANExpression` hold their types weakly and no longer keep a collectible `AssemblyLoadContext` (plugin) loaded; prompt cancellation and O(n) completion order in `YANTask`; robust `YANProcess` kills; `Snowflake` sequence, extraction and validation fixes; order-preserving collection helpers.
* **Faster**: TryParse instead of exceptions, no boxing in typed `Sum`/`Average` of non-nullable numbers, compiled property accessors in `YANObject`.
* **Behaviour changes to check**: `IdGenerator.NextId*` throws for an epoch in the future or 2^41 ms or more in the past; `GenerateRandom<T>(a, b)` with two typed numeric, `DateTime` or `char` arguments returns a value in [a, b); inherited properties count in `IsNullDefault`; `Copy()` throws `NotSupportedException` for collection types (`IList`, `IDictionary`, `ICollection`, `ICollection<T>`), which 8.3.3 copied without their items (unless a settable property held them) or failed on (for example `TargetParameterCountException` for `List<T>` and `Dictionary<TKey, TValue>`); the `Parse<DateTime>` default fallback above (was `DateTime.MinValue`); the `[Obsolete]` `Extract*Components` strategy overloads that take `sequence` give warning CS0618, an error with warnings as errors; the collection helpers that return a sequence, apart from the `YANRandom` generators, keep the input order (no more unordered PLINQ).
* **Package**: ships XML docs, no `favicon.ico` content file, API validated against 8.3.3.

Full list: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Tynab/YANLib/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Documentation: [https://github.com/Tynab/YANLib/wiki](https://github.com/Tynab/YANLib/wiki)
